teaser.en: Unusually for a palm, it branches, and its leaf strips are behind one of the best-known Digo plant names: *mlala*.
teaser.sw: Jambo lisilo la kawaida kwa mchikichi, mti huu hutoa matawi, na vipande vya majani yake ndivyo chanzo cha mojawapo ya majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayojulikana zaidi: *mlala*.
teaser.dg: Si dza mihi yanjina ya jamii ya minazi, uhu una panda, na vipande vya makodzage ndivyo vinavyoreha dzina ra mmea ririromanyikana zaidi kpwa Chidigo: *mlala*.

summary.en: *Mkoma*, the doum palm, is a tall fan palm that branches again and again, and its hard, shiny fruits are called *koma*. Its leaves, *mlala*, are the coast's great weaving material, and its fruit has saved lives in famine.
summary.sw: *Mkoma* ni mchikichi mrefu wenye majani kama kipepeo unaotoa matawi tena na tena, na matunda yake magumu yanayong'aa huitwa *koma*. Majani yake, *mlala*, ndiyo malighafi kuu ya kusuka pwani, na tunda lake limeokoa maisha wakati wa njaa.
summary.dg: *Mkoma* ni muhi mure wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero unaoganyika panda chila mara, na matundage magumu ganagong'ala ganaihwa *koma*. Makodzage, *mlala*, ndigo vitu vikulu vya kusukira pwani, na tundare rikaokola maisha wakati wa ndzala.

about.en:
*Mkoma* is one of very few palms that branch. Its trunk forks into two, and each branch may fork again, so an old tree can reach 25 metres with several crowns. Each crown carries stiff fan leaves on stalks edged with sharp spines.

The fruits hang in heavy clusters. They are hard, shiny and orange-brown, somewhat flattened, with a fibrous, sweetish pulp around a very hard kernel. The Digo call the fruit *koma*.
about.sw:
*Mkoma* ni mojawapo ya michikichi michache sana inayotoa matawi. Shina lake hugawanyika mara mbili, na kila tawi linaweza kugawanyika tena, kwa hivyo mti mzee unaweza kufikia mita 25 ukiwa na mataji kadhaa. Kila taji hubeba majani magumu kama kipepeo juu ya vikonyo vyenye miiba mikali pembeni.

Matunda huning'inia kwa vishada vizito. Ni magumu, yanayong'aa na ya rangi ya kahawia-machungwa, yaliyobapa kidogo, yenye nyama ya nyuzinyuzi tamu kiasi inayozunguka kiini kigumu sana. Wadigo huliita tunda hili *koma*.
about.dg:
*Mkoma* ni mwenga wa mihi michache sana ya jamii ya minazi inayoganyika panda. Kolore rinaganyika mairi, na chila panda inaweza kuganyika tsena, ndiyo mana muhi wa kare unaweza kufika mita 25 na chitswa zaidi ya chimwenga. Chila chitswa chinatsukula makodza mafu ga chiphephero kpwa milita yenye miya ya ntsa kanda-kanda.

Matunda ganabwadzika kpwa mabunda mazito. Ni magumu, ganang'ala na ga rangi ya chungbwa na dongo, ga kubanika chidide, na genye nyama ya nyuzi-nyuzi ya mtswano chidide kuzunguluka chitsa gumu sana. Adigo anaiha tunda hiri *koma*.

where.en: It grows in hot lowlands, along river courses and on the coastal plain: in coastal grassland, bushland and on sandy plains. On the drive inland from the south coast, its branched silhouettes stand out above the bush.
where.sw: Hustawi katika nyanda za chini zenye joto, kando ya mito na katika nyanda za pwani: katika nyika za nyasi za pwani, vichakani na kwenye nyanda za mchanga. Ukisafiri kuelekea bara kutoka pwani ya kusini, maumbo yake yenye matawi hujitokeza juu ya kichaka.
where.dg: Unamera kpwa tsi za photsi zenye dzoho, kanda-kanda ya miho na kpwa tsi ya photsi ya pwani: nyasini, weruni na kpwa herera za mtsanga. Uchiphiya na gari kula pwani ya kusini kuphiya bara, maumbo ga pandaze ganaonekana dzulu ya weruni.

uses.en:
The leaves, called *mlala*, are the coast's great weaving material. They are split into strips and woven into mats, baskets, hats and other handicrafts, and used for roofing.

The fruit pulp and the kernel are eaten, and in hard times the fruit is an important famine food. The stem is tapped for palm wine. Trunks serve as poles and are hollowed into beehives.
uses.sw:
Majani, yanayoitwa *mlala*, ndiyo malighafi kuu ya kusuka pwani. Hupasuliwa kuwa vipande na kusukwa kuwa mikeka, vikapu, kofia na kazi nyingine za mikono, na hutumika kuezekea.

Nyama ya tunda na kiini huliwa, na nyakati ngumu tunda hili ni chakula muhimu cha njaa. Shina hugemwa ili kupata tembo. Mashina hutumika kama nguzo na huchongwa kuwa mizinga ya nyuki.
uses.dg:
Makodza, ganagoihwa *mlala*, ndigo vitu vikulu vya kusukira pwani. Nkugbwanyulwa vipande na kusukwa majamvi, kaphu, kofiya na kazi zanjina za mikpwono, na piya nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba.

Nyama ya tunda na chitsa nkuriwa, na wakati wa shida tunda ni chakurya cha muhimu cha ndzala. Kolo nkujemwa kpwa uchi. Makolo nkuhumirwa dza nguzo na nkutsimbwa ndani kuhenda mizinga ya nyuchi.

culture.en: *Mlala*, the leaf and the weaving material, is one of the most widely known Digo plant names, as Pakia found. Mats and baskets of *mlala* have long been part of everyday life in Digo homes.
culture.sw: *Mlala*, jani na malighafi ya kusuka, ni mojawapo ya majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanayojulikana na watu wengi zaidi, kama Pakia alivyogundua. Mikeka na vikapu vya *mlala* vimekuwa sehemu ya maisha ya kila siku katika nyumba za Wadigo tangu zamani.
culture.dg: *Mlala*, kodza na chitu cha kusukira, ni mwenga wa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo ganagomanyikana zaidi, dza Pakia arivyoona. Majamvi na kaphu za *mlala* zikakala seemu ya maisha ga chila siku kpwa midzi ya Adigo kula kare.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mkoma*, also *mkoma lume*, and lists *mlala* among the weaving plants. The Mgombato dictionary gives *mkoma* for both the doum palm and the dwarf doum palm, and *mlala* as 'raffia', so speakers may use *mlala* for the leaf material more broadly. In Swahili it is *mkoma*, *mkoche* or *mlala*. In Giriama it is *mkoma* or *mlala*, and in Chonyi *mkoma*. In English it is the doum palm, and its scientific name is *Hyphaene compressa*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mkoma*, pia *mkoma lume*, na anaorodhesha *mlala* miongoni mwa mimea ya kusuka. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mkoma* kwa mkoma na pia kwa mkoma mfupi, na *mlala* kama 'raffia', kwa hivyo huenda wazungumzaji hutumia *mlala* kwa malighafi ya majani kwa upana zaidi. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkoma*, *mkoche* au *mlala*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mkoma* au *mlala*, na kwa Kichonyi *mkoma*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *doum palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Hyphaene compressa*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mkoma*, piya *mkoma lume*, na anataja *mlala* kahi ya mimea ya kusukira. Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mkoma* kpwa mkoma na mkoma mdide, na *mlala* dza 'raffia', kpwa hivyo atu anaweza kuhumira *mlala* kpwa makodza ga kusukira kpwa ujumla. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mkoma*, *mkoche* au *mlala*. Kpwa Chigiryama *mkoma* au *mlala*, na kpwa Chichonyi *mkoma*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *doum palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Hyphaene compressa*.

reason.en: Same genus: the dwarf doum palm
The raffia palm, whose name overlaps with mlala in Mgombato
reason.sw: Mwale, ambao jina lake linaingiliana na mlala katika Mgombato
reason.dg: Mtsikitsi, ambao Mgombato piya inauiha mlala

reason.sw: Mchikichi mwingine mrefu wenye majani kama kipepeo
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina mure wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero

reason.sw: Pia hugemwa ili kupata tembo na hutumika kuezekea
reason.dg: Piya nkujemwa kpwa uchi na nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba

definition.en: The leaves of a young fan palm (doum or borassus). The name depends on the palm's age because only young plants' leaves are useful.
definition.sw: Majani ya mchikichi mchanga wenye majani kama kipepeo (mkoma au mvumo). Jina hutegemea umri wa mchikichi kwa sababu ni majani ya mimea michanga tu yanayofaa.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi mtsanga wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo). Dzina rinakuluphira umri wa muhi kpwa sababu ni makodza ga mihi mitsanga bahi ganagofwaha.

use.en: Woven into mats, baskets, hats and other items.
use.sw: Husukwa kuwa mikeka, vikapu, kofia na vitu vingine.
use.dg: Nkusukwa majamvi, kaphu, kofiya na vitu vyanjina.

meaning.en: From an older word meaning 'dwarf palm'. Mgombato glosses mlala as 'raffia', the weaving fibre.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la zamani lenye maana ya 'mchikichi mfupi'. Mgombato anaeleza mlala kama 'raffia', nyuzi za kusuka.
meaning.dg: Kula kpwa neno ra kare ririrokala na mana ya 'muhi mdide wa jamii ya mnazi'. Mgombato inaandika *mlala* dza 'raffia', nyuzi za kusukira.

shared_with: bangalala: the leaves of the mature palm

definition.en: The leaves of a mature fan palm (doum or borassus), which are not used for weaving.
definition.sw: Majani ya mchikichi uliokomaa wenye majani kama kipepeo (mkoma au mvumo), ambayo hayatumiki kusuka.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo) uriokula, ambago tagahumirwa kusukira.

shared_with: mlala: the leaves of the young palm

definition.en: The fruit of the doum palm.
A strip of raffia (mlala) about 5 mm wide.
definition.sw: Kipande cha ukindu (mlala) chenye upana wa takriban milimita 5.
definition.dg: Chipande cha mlala cha upana wa phephi milimita 5.

definition.en: Pieces of raffia (mlala) ready for weaving. The Swahili gloss, minyaa, refers to strips of doum palm leaf.
definition.sw: Vipande vya ukindu (mlala) vilivyo tayari kusukwa. Maana ya Kiswahili, minyaa, inahusu vipande vya jani la mkoma.
definition.dg: Vipande vya mlala viriviotayarishwa kusukwa. Neno ra Chiswahili, *minyaa*, ni vipande vya makodza ga mkoma.

definition.en: The hard edges of raffia (mlala) leaves, made into very fine thread for sewing plaits together into a mat or basket.
definition.sw: Kingo ngumu za majani ya ukindu (mlala), zinazotengenezwa kuwa uzi mwembamba sana wa kushonea misuko pamoja kuwa mkeka au kikapu.
definition.dg: Kanda ngumu za makodza ga mlala, zinazohendwa nyuzi nyembamba sana za kushonera misuko phamwenga kuhenda jamvi au kaphu.

definition.en: The tender, edible part between the stem and the leaves. Mgombato gives it for the coconut palm and for 'raffia' (mlala), which here is probably the doum palm.
definition.sw: Sehemu laini inayolika iliyo kati ya shina na majani. Mgombato analitoa kwa mnazi na kwa 'raffia' (mlala), ambayo hapa huenda ni mkoma.
definition.dg: Seemu ya yuya inayoriwa iriyo kahi ya kolo na makodza. Mgombato inaipha kpwa mnazi na kpwa 'raffia' (*mlala*), ambayo hipha labuda ni mkoma.

mgombato: mkoma (mi) dwarf or doum palm (Hyphanae coriacea; H. compressa); mkoma, mlala, mkoche.
